name: PG (Prospecting)
description: Builds account research for sales outreach, mining recent podcast and webinar appearances for the kind of personal detail that gives an opener somewhere to start. Can be granted X or LinkedIn access to widen the search, though it works without that if you would rather not connect accounts.
